entries: If more humans cared for booksss... there would be less trouble between us. Knowledge challenges our perceptionsss... frightening to some, yes?
若是更多人类肯在意书，嘶……我们之间的麻烦就会少些。知识会挑战人的认知，嘶……对某些人来说很可怕，对吧？
We do not bury our dead as you do. We eat them! *cackle* Really. It isss true.
我们不照你们的方式安葬死者。我们，吃掉他们！*咯咯笑* 真的。嘶，是真的。
How unusual to sssee a fae again. This distresssses me.
嘶……居然还能再见到一位妖精。这让我很不安。
A central hub for many humansss. Older than you think. My people once came here as well.
许多人类的……嘶……汇聚之地。它比你想象的更古老。我的族人从前也来过这里。
Do not take lightly that which is in books. Some liesss, some truth. But where knowledge and truth combine, there is power. Time sifts the lies from written word. Truth persists.
别轻视书里的东西。其中有谎言……嘶……也有真相。但知识与真相交汇之处，便蕴藏力量。时间会从字句中筛去谎言，真相则留存。
What has befallen the outside world isss of no concern to me.
外面的世界遭遇了什么……嘶……与我无关。
One must delve deep to find sssuch ore. Too deep for my liking.
要找到那样的矿石……嘶……得往深处挖。深得让我不喜欢。
This is the word that you gave usss... it does not matter. People are called many things, both good and bad, but actions will prove which are true.
这就是你们给我们的名号，嘶……算了。人们会被冠上各种称呼，有褒有贬，但行动自会证明哪一个是真。
Sssss! Long has it been, thinking I would have the privilege of never seeing your kind again. Why must you upset me so?
嘶……！都这么久了，我本以为有福气再也不见你的族类。你何苦又来惹我心烦？
Clever. Tricky. Wicked. Tasssty... When they betray, we take what is owed.
聪明。狡诈。邪恶。啧，嘶，很美味……它们若背信，我们便取回应得之物。
I have memories of humansss, but they are faint. Time has taken much from me. Yet you seem familiar.
我记着一些关于人类的……嘶……记忆，但很模糊。时间从我这里带走了太多。可你看起来……似曾相识。
Plump. Round. ... I should stop, lessst I upset my new guests.
圆润。饱满。……我该住口了，嘶，免得吓到我的新客人。
The dew drips from above, as does the rain. Thisss is fog, yes?
露水自上方滴落，雨水也是。这……嘶……就是雾，对吧？

Outcast? No. Hermit... perhapsss? I am here by choice. The outside world is troublesome.

May I interest you in necklaces?

被放逐者？不是。隐士……嘶，也许吧？我在这里是自愿的。外面的世界太麻烦。

要看看项链吗？我很乐意为您介绍。
It hasss been long since humans have entered my home.
已经很久嘶，没有人类踏进我的家了。
Ressspect, old one. We have at least age in common, though, I imagine I am much older.
敬……嘶……敬重，长者。至少我们还共有一件东西：年纪。尽管我想，我比您年长得多。
Ssssooo. You have this thing? It is ancient. Take care... truth can burn away the shadowssss. Shadows that some have spent their lives sssseeking.
嘶……所……以。这东西在你手上？它非常古老。小心些……真相会烧尽阴影，嘶。而那些阴影，有些人穷尽一生都在追寻。
Not quite like home. But good enough.
From Miala they rained down. Our world isss better for it. Miala... not so much.
它们曾从米亚拉倾落如雨。我们的世界因此更美好，嘶。米亚拉……就没那么好了。
Humansss, they think of him as a man. As a human man. This is a false image. He... it.. is more than that, and greatly to be feared.
人类……嘶……以为他是个男人。一个人类男子。那是假的形象。他……或者说「它」……远不止于此，且极为可怖。
Deliciousss, and fierce. Easily enraged... like some humans.
美……嘶……味，又凶猛。极易激怒……像某些人类一样。
Musssic. It is one of the best things to come from humans. Many other... terrible things have come as well.
音……嘶……乐。那是人类带来的最好的东西之一。当然也带来了许多……可怕之物。
Isss... it food? Why do the others bring such a creature?
它……嘶……是食物吗？其他人为什么带这么个生物来？
Few good relations. Mossstly, uninteresting. We inhabit the same places in this world. That leads to conflict. Such is true of all races.
没什么好交情。大……嘶……多说不上有趣。我们与他们栖息在这世界的同一片土地上，于是便有冲突。所有种族都是如此。
A good human, yesss. Few of them I think. Few good of my people as well. This is the nature of all.
一个好人，嘶。我想这样的人类不多。我的族人中好人也少。万物的天性使然。
I have heard of thisss legend. It is of no concern to me. I wisssh to be left in peace.
这个传说……嘶……我听过。与我无关。我只希望……嘶……清静度日。
Miala, Gammon, and Tethrysss. Many runes have been made, in this region, that respond to their light, or lack of it. Many secrets to be found... yesss...
米亚拉、加蒙、泰丝瑞斯，嘶。这一带制作过许多符文，会对月光的明灭起反应。许多秘密等着被发现，嘶……没错……
Yeessss. You speak of thingsss many have forgotten. I have seen sssuch a gate. In a cave, yes, but ssstill the sssun and moon reach it.
是……嘶……的。你说的那些……嘶……许多人早已遗忘。我见过那样的门。在洞穴里，没错，但日光与月光依旧能触及它。
The men of my home are strong as well. Perhapsss you will fight them someday.
我家乡的男儿同样强悍。嘶……也许有一天，你会与他们交手。
I chossse the rune of Miala to protect me here, for its light lasts longer than any other at a time, and it gives power to my forging. Then, I ressst, and begin agian.
我选了米亚拉的符文守护此地，嘶，它的光在一次显现中比任何月亮都持久，还能为我的锻造供能。然后我休……嘶……息，再重新开始。
Did you know, you can travel there, with the proper runesss? Yesss... but such arcane arts are lost to most. Humans destroy too much to remember.
你知道吗？只要有合适的符文……嘶……你也能去那里。没错……但这类奥术，大多数人已经失传了。人类毁掉的东西太多，记不住。
